_comment: Ed25519 public keys trusted to sign an Azazel-Fabric release-candidate
The id is free-form and is what the .sig file names. The value is the
32-byte Ed25519 PUBLIC key, hex-encoded. Several keys may be trusted at
once, which is how a rotation happens without a flag day.
A private key never belongs in this repository.
The format is Azazel-Knowledge's (bundle/verify.py), reused so one
